claims.claim: Xbox Series S console (white-and-blue) with 2 controllers.
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a white-and-blue Xbox-style console with two controllers on top; witness identity reads 'Xbox Series S' from photo 1 and photo 2.
Photos show the console/controllers look intact, but do not show power-on, button/stick function, overheating, or internal condition.
Photos do not confirm origin (UK) or usage history.

claims.claim: It comes with 'Fc26 Package and other...'.
claims.evidence: No photo evidence of what 'Fc26 Package' includes; accessories are not shown.
Witness identity and photos indicate 'Xbox Series S' (white-and-blue Series S style), not Xbox One.

risks.risk: Not confirmed working: console may not power on/boot or may have faults not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A short video clip of power-on to the dashboard (or boot screen) with the console showing it loads successfully.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not fully tested/unknown working condition until a boot test is shown.

risks.risk: Storage size and whether it’s expanded are unknown; Series S variants differ and value changes.
risks.proof: A screenshot/photo from Settings showing 'Storage' capacity (and whether an expansion drive is installed).
risks.if_unproven: Priced at the lowest/most basic capacity scenario until storage capacity is confirmed.

risks.risk: Controller functionality and battery/charging status are unknown (sticks drift, dead buttons, weak battery).
risks.proof: A clip showing both controllers connected and responding in a game/menu, plus a battery/charging indicator screen if available.
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming controllers may need service/are not guaranteed for perfect input and battery performance.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (power cable, HDMI cable, controller charging cable/dongle if applicable) could reduce usability.
risks.proof: A photo/clip laying out every included item: power brick/cable, HDMI cable, and any controller charging accessories/dongles.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as 'console + controllers only' until all required cables/accessories are confirmed.

risks.risk: Cosmetic/physical wear not fully visible: scratches, dents, port wear, or fan/overheating issues.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of ports (HDMI/USB/power), vents/fan area, and a short run test showing no overheating/throttling.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at worst-case cosmetic/usage wear since damage and thermals can’t be verified from the current photos.

risks.risk: Account/reset status unknown: console may still be signed in or not factory reset, causing setup/account issues.
risks.proof: A screenshot/clip from Settings showing the console is factory reset/ready for setup (or the sign-in screen after reset).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as 'account/reset status unknown' until reset readiness is demonstrated.

proof_requests: Power-on/boot video to the Xbox dashboard (showing it loads successfully).
Screenshot of Settings > System > Storage showing exact capacity and whether expansion is installed.
Video showing both controllers connected and working (buttons + thumbsticks) and battery/charging status.
Photos/clip of all included accessories laid out (power cable/brick, HDMI, any controller charging accessories/dongles).
Close-up photos of all ports and vents/fan area; ideally a short run test to confirm no overheating noise.
Screenshot/clip confirming factory reset status (ready for new owner setup).
response.reason: The witness can identify the console family and that there are two controllers, but key value drivers (working status, storage capacity, controller battery/charging, included cables, and reset/account status) are not verifiable from the photos. Proof is needed before a reliable price can be set.
